messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a spike of stream drops (~6k) on eu-edge over the last 45m. Pattern: proxy emits delayed ACKs, router flips to fallback shard, client reconnects => resume id mismatch + duplicate billing. Ops alerted.
kevin: Ugh. Any idea which rollout touched routing or proxy config? can you paste a minimal log sample? @june
june: We pushed route-policy v2 to eu yesterday 15:55 as a gradual canary (10% -> 50%). Nothing else in infra. Was supposed to be safe.
maria: Sample (redacted):
```
[eu-proxy-13] 2026-03-23T16:10:05Z INFO ack_delayed route_swap=true session_id=abc123 resume_id=RID-456 cost_unit=1
[router-7] 2026-03-23T16:10:06Z WARN resume_mismatch session_id=abc123 prev_shard=s-09 new_shard=s-22
[ingest] 2026-03-23T16:10:07Z ERROR client_reconnect id=cid-890 code=1006
```
maria: Observed behavior: proxy queues ACK waiting for a late in-flight frame, TTL expires -> router marks lease lost -> route swap -> resume token no longer valid. The client reconnect path then consumes a new resume (double-count).
kevin: Do we have a sampling that shows if late ACKs spike only when route-policy v2 is applied?
telemetry-bot: quick check: correlate(edge=eu,policy=v2) -> connect_failures up by 4.8x starting 15:58. (short sampling)
june: Interesting. v2 changed sticky-lease timeout from 30s -> 8s for high-util shards to free up capacity. That might make router evict earlier on delayed ACKs.
maria: Exactly — shorter lease + occasional proxy buffering creates the window. That explains the route flips. But dashboard only shows reconnects, not the ack_delayed metric so we had blind spot.
kevin: Two problems: (1) UX/console doesn't surface late ACKs or route-evictions as first-class metrics, making diagnosis slow. (2) Billing/backfill: an A/B route swap caused resume replays and duplicate token usage. We need both telemetry and billing guardrails.
telemetry-bot: Proposed quick queries to backfill:
```
-- count late ack related events
SELECT count(*) FROM stream_events WHERE region='eu' AND event IN ('ack_delayed','resume_mismatch') AND ts >= '2026-03-23T15:50:00Z';
```
telemetry-bot: Also recommend adding a console metric: streaming.route_eviction_rate and streaming.late_ack_rate (per-region + per-policy). Backfill saved to /dashboards/staging/streaming-late-acks.json
june: Agreed. For rollouts: revert sticky-lease timeout change to 30s for the canary group and re-evaluate with latency p95 for proxy ack path.
maria: For immediate mitigation -> patch router to treat a short late-ack window as non-eviction (grace of 2s) to avoid flip. Can we hotfix?
kevin: That should be safe, but need tests. Also add a quota-safety: when resume_count for a session >1 within 10s, mark as suspect and don't bill until manual review (temporary). Ops/finance to confirm.
june: I'll open a rollback PR for v2 (canary group only) and a follow-up to bump sticky-lease back.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260323-89 "eu-edge late-ack route flips causing reconnects and duplicate billing". Assigning to eng-platform.
telemetry-bot: Action items: (1) backfill query (done, results attached), (2) add metrics and dashboard tile in staging, (3) short-term router grace patch + tests, (4) temporary billing hold for resume duplicates.
maria: I'll collect more session traces and paste them into the incident. Thanks. :thumbsup:
kevin: Ping me when PRs exist, I'll review the router patch.
june: Will coordinate rollback and postmortem template.
ops-bot: Pager duty notify sent to oncall-eng-platform.
